DavidBoja/Landmarks2Anthropometry main @ de2df48dd428dce457339141c709d7510e0e6f2b
Vendored: 2026-10-02 (pristine upstream, unmodified — nested .git removed
for a plain-file vendor snapshot, exactly like vendor/fashn-vton-1.5)

What this is (decision record):
  - Upstream research code for "Landmarks2Anthropometry: A step towards
    body measurements from 2D landmarks" (VISAPP 2024, David Boja).
  - Used by Feature 05 (photo -> body measurements) as the regression
    model layer: per-measurement BayesianRidge bundles (models/male.pkl,
    models/female.pkl) predicting circumference estimates from pose
    landmark configurations.
  - The landmark detector is Google MediaPipe pose_landmarker_heavy
    (Apache-2.0) — NOT vendored here; the Modal worker image installs it
    from PyPI.

LICENSE HONESTY (read before shipping):
  - The upstream repository carries NO license file. Under GitHub's
    default terms the author retains all rights; absent an explicit
    permissive grant this code is UNLICENSED-RESEARCH-ONLY.
  - Consequence for CONFIT: the deployed worker reports
    license=unlicensed-research-only, commercial=false in EVERY response,
    and the API surface carries the mandatory ±2-3 cm accuracy
    disclosure. Feature 05 is a pilot-tier capability on this basis —
    commercial use requires either an upstream license grant or a
    reimplementation under a permissive model set.
  - models/*..pkl are trained artifacts distributed by the author under
    the same (absent) license — same constraint.

Provenance of this snapshot:
  - Cloned from https://github.com/DavidBoja/Landmarks2Anthropometry at
    commit de2df48dd428dce457339141c709d7510e0e6f2b (recorded verbatim
    in the worker's response as model.vendor_commit).
  - Files kept: estimate_measurements.py, landmark_utils.py,
    measurement_utils.py, models/, data/, assets/, README.md.
  - Files dropped: none besides .git metadata and __pycache__.
